title: Dell's AI Server Backlog Hits a Record $132 Billion
dek: Record quarter pushes Dell's full-year forecast up to $202 billion.
caption:
Dell isn't really a PC company anymore. 📈

Dell just reported record third-quarter revenue of $54.9 billion, up 103% from a year ago, and its backlog of AI server orders reached $132.3 billion. AI-optimized servers alone brought in $22 billion, up 291%, while the PC business grew only about 3%.

On the back of that demand, Dell raised its full-year forecast to $202 billion, above Wall Street expectations. More than 7,500 customers now run Dell AI Factories, and the company booked $60.2 billion in new AI orders in a single quarter.

Why it matters: the AI data center buildout behind chatbots and AI agents is speeding up, not cooling off. Power and cash flow are the limits to watch. We're tracking it daily at AI Parabellum.
